title: Heavy shelling reported in Kharkiv region
summary: Ukrainian forces repelled multiple Russian assault attempts near Vovchansk. Artillery and drone attacks continued overnight across the Kharkiv Oblast.

title: Drone strikes hit Russian oil facilities in Saratov
summary: Ukrainian long-range drones struck oil refinery infrastructure in Saratov Oblast, causing fires that burned for several hours. Russia's air defense intercepted 12 of 18 drones.

title: IDF expands operations in northern Gaza
summary: Israeli forces intensified ground operations in Jabalia refugee camp. At least 34 Palestinians killed in 24-hour period according to Gaza Health Ministry.

title: Ceasefire talks resume in Qatar
summary: Hamas and Israeli delegations resumed indirect ceasefire negotiations mediated by Qatar and Egypt. No breakthrough reported. US envoy Steve Witkoff present.

title: RSF attacks Omdurman residential areas
summary: Rapid Support Forces launched artillery barrages into residential neighborhoods of Omdurman. Multiple casualties reported. UN estimates 10 million displaced.

title: M23 advances toward Bukavu in eastern DRC
summary: M23 rebels, backed by Rwandan forces, continued their push toward Bukavu. FARDC defense lines reportedly breached in two locations. 500,000 civilians at risk.

title: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant loses external power again
summary: IAEA reports Zaporizhzhia NPP lost external power connection for the 12th time. Emergency diesel generators activated. IAEA monitoring continues on-site.

title: Houthis attack commercial vessel in Red Sea
summary: Houthi forces launched ballistic missile and drone attack on a Liberian-flagged cargo vessel in the southern Red Sea. US Navy intercepted multiple projectiles. No casualties reported.

title: Resistance forces capture key town in Shan State
summary: Brotherhood Alliance captured Muse township near Chinese border. Junta forces retreated after three days of fighting. Strategic crossing point now under resistance control.

title: JNIM attack kills 15 soldiers in Burkina Faso
summary: Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin launched coordinated attack on military convoy near Djibo. 15 VDP fighters killed, 8 wounded. Fourth attack this week.

title: Gang siege leaves 60,000 Haitians trapped
summary: Viv Ansanm gang coalition continues siege of Cité Soleil. MSS forces unable to break through. Food and water supplies critically depleted. WHO declares health emergency.

title: Zelensky calls for new military aid package
summary: President Zelensky addressed EU Parliament requesting additional air defense systems and long-range munitions. EU approved €5bn aid package in response.

title: Humanitarian aid convoy blocked at Kerem Shalom
summary: WFP reports 47 aid trucks blocked from entering Gaza for third consecutive day. UN Secretary-General warns of imminent famine conditions in northern Gaza.

title: Al-Shabaab kills 12 in Mogadishu bombing
summary: Suicide bombing at Mogadishu checkpoint killed 12 civilians and wounded 19. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility. Second major attack in the capital this month.

title: Russia launches overnight Shahed drone barrage
summary: Russia launched 34 Shahed-136 drones targeting Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Air defense shot down 28. Power grid repairs underway in 3 oblasts.

title: Settler violence destroys olive orchards near Nablus
summary: Settlers destroyed 200+ olive trees near Burin village. Three Palestinians injured in confrontations. IDF present but did not intervene according to witnesses.

title: UN Security Council emergency session on DRC
summary: UNSC convened emergency session on DRC crisis. Rwanda denied supporting M23. France and UK called for immediate ceasefire. No resolution reached.

title: ICC issues arrest warrant for RSF commander
summary: International Criminal Court issued arrest warrant for senior RSF commander over war crimes in Darfur including mass killings and sexual violence against civilians.

title: Junta airstrikes kill 20 civilians in Sagaing
summary: Military jets bombed a village gathering in Sagaing region killing 20 civilians including 6 children. AAPP condemned the airstrike as a war crime.

title: Mali junta expels last French diplomats
summary: Mali's military government ordered final 4 French diplomatic staff to leave within 48 hours. France closed its embassy. Russia's Wagner Group continues to expand presence.

title: Clashes resume in Amhara region
summary: Fighting between Ethiopian federal forces and Fano militia resumed in northern Amhara. 30+ casualties reported. Ceasefire agreement from 2022 under strain.

title: US airstrikes target Houthi command centers
summary: US Central Command conducted precision strikes on Houthi military command infrastructure in Sanaa and Hodeidah. Houthis vow to continue Red Sea operations.
